---
description: Instructions for frontend code in the frontend/ directory
applyTo: 'frontend/**'
---

You are working on the frontend of this project.

- Prefer functional components and React hooks over class components
- Use TypeScript strictly — avoid `any` types
- Keep components small and focused; extract reusable logic into custom hooks
- Co-locate styles, tests, and components where possible
- Ensure UI is accessible (semantic HTML, ARIA attributes where needed)
- Validate all user inputs on the client side before sending to the API
